name: snap
description: 快门 - 本地视频取景与横截竖图工具
author: qh775885

scripts.clean: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "if (Test-Path dist) { Remove-Item dist -Recurse -Force }; if (Test-Path release) { Remove-Item release -Recurse -Force }"
scripts.build: npx tauri build --no-bundle && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$outDir = 'release/快门-免安装绿色版'; if (!(Test-Path $outDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $outDir -Force | Out-Null }; Copy-Item 'src-tauri/target/release/snap.exe' (Join-Path $outDir '快门.exe') -Force; Copy-Item 'src-tauri/target/release/WebView2Loader.dll' (Join-Path $outDir 'WebView2Loader.dll') -Force; Write-Host '绿色免安装版已输出至 release/快门-免安装绿色版/'"
